name: Employee Onboarding Form
objective: Capture personal contact parameters, emergency contacts, and banking remittance setups.

attributes.name: Employee Full Name
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the employee's full legal name.

attributes.name: Personal Email
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the employee's personal email address.

attributes.name: Phone Number
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the employee's contact phone number.

attributes.name: Nationality
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the nationality / country of citizenship.

attributes.name: Emergency Contact Phone
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the emergency contact's phone number.

attributes.name: Bank Name
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the bank name for salary remittance.

attributes.name: Tax / Social Security ID
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the tax or social security identifier.
